extracted.name: Hot Ginger Milk
extracted.description: Hot milk with ginger is a real treat on a cold winter night. A touch of sugar sweetens things up, while ground ginger adds a mild hit of peppery spice.
instruction_lines: Cook milk, sugar, and ground ginger in a saucepan over medium heat until milk becomes foamy, about 5 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Strain through a fine-mesh strainer into a mug.
